title: Knowledge Base Document v0.1
description: One ingested document in the local knowledge base: its text, where it came from, when it was taken in, and how its text was recovered. Distinct from working_memory (agent-proposed candidates about how to work) and operational_knowledge (validated operating truth with a review window) — this record makes no truth claim at all. It says only: this text was supplied, from this source, at this time.

source.description: Where the document came from, as the caller states it: a filename, a URL, an analyst's name, a report id. Free text on purpose — a closed vocabulary here would be guessed at rather than obeyed.

document_date.description: The date the document is ABOUT, when the caller knows it — distinct from ingested_at_utc, which is when this runtime received it. A daily analysis filed three days late is dated by its subject, not its filing.

content_sha256.description: Hash of the normalized text. Two ingests of the same content collide here, which is how a re-ingest is recognized as a duplicate rather than stored twice and then returned twice in one answer.

extraction.description: How the text was recovered. Null for text supplied directly. Present for a PDF, and kept because the answer to 'why does this document read badly' is almost always in which backend won.

superseded_by.description: Set when a later ingest replaces this document. The row stays — the store is append-only and the history of what was believed when is part of what it holds.
